I'm sure they'll wreak havoc on my circuitry.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Missions 6">''[[Star Wars Missions 6: The Search for Grubba the Hutt]]''</ref>}}
'''Ku'Bakai''' was the [[Ku'Bakai system/Legends|Ku'Bakai system's]] primary [[Star/Legends|star]]. It was a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] star that shot out powerful [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]].
